notes: Survey bounds are approximate observations in DIFFERENT stationary vehicle frames; never join as absolute coordinates. Fixed-shape templates trigger based on NEW LiDAR obstacle observations; keep CAMERA lane tracking elsewhere. Check swept path and both boundaries on every accepted candidate; do not force a turn at waypoint or time. Not yet validated with live MORAI. V49: SECOND_RIGHT uses matching against stationary scan, then two separately LiDAR-verified maneuvers; no blind return.

second_survey_match.notes: Survey second obstacle y shifts with vehicle offset. Match relative to observed left tunnel wall, near x17.5m, for 2 consecutive fresh scans. On no match/mismatch continue CAMERA lane tracking; do not request STOP except if central object enters <8m or a candidate's swept path/visibility is unsafe. Survey wall gap is an estimate requiring MORAI validation.

first_left_hold.notes: First LEFT uses the original entry curvature and offset but holds lateral position past obstacle rather than forced right return. LiDAR swept path, side wall and endpoint observation must still all pass before route activation.
